evals.prompt: Use cgd-non-designers-design-skill to create, review, and refine a poster for a quiet photography exhibition called Night Windows. Only that coordinating skill is installed in this environment; no other cgd skill is available. Do not install anything or use a development checkout as a substitute. Save status.md explaining whether you can run the combined workflow and what is needed if not.
evals.expected_output: A short status explaining that the combined workflow needs cgd-non-designers-design-create and cgd-non-designers-design-review installed alongside the coordinator; no invented design work or installation.
assertions: The status identifies both cgd-non-designers-design-create and cgd-non-designers-design-review as required companions.
The agent does not claim to have created or reviewed a poster and produces no design artifact.
The response asks for the missing companions to be made available without installing anything or substituting development copies.
